'''Namen Takamen''' was a [[Rebel pilot]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Green Squadron]] who flew as [[Green Seven]]. They most notably fought in the [[battle of Scarif]].<ref name="Rogue One Visual Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Takamen_helmet.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Namen Takamen's flight helmet]]
Namen Takamen's appeared in his fighter in ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Rogue One">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> He was then identified in the ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' and his helmet was pictured although not Takamen himself.<ref name="Rogue One Visual Guide" />
